verdict.rationale: ELSTER documents that any third-party tax software supporting ELSTER can transmit filings through its rail, and that registration issues a certificate for unsigned electronic submission, so a sanctioned software-to-service channel exists. The evidence does not document the developer interface itself or how software vendors or batch transmitters enroll. The one probe found the ERiC artifact host timing out on a single attempt, which is weak and does not contradict the channel's existence. Missing for 10: published developer/transmitter enrollment path, documentation of the ERiC interface or system/batch accounts, independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic transmission.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
